item.title: N.Y. Knicks Sweep 2026 ESPYS as Show Returns to New York: Full Winners List
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Energetic music plays in the background]
Host: Welcome to the podcast! We're here to talk about the 2026 ESPY Awards, and what a night it was! The New York Knicks, fresh off their NBA Finals win, swept the awards show, taking home several top honors.
[Sound effects: Cheers and applause]
Host: The Knicks were named Best Team, while their star player Jalen Brunson won Best Athlete in Men's Sports, Best Championship Performance, and Best NBA Player. Not to mention, his teammate OG Anunoby's game-winning tip-in in the NBA Finals took home the award for Best Play.
[Music transitions to a smooth and upbeat tune]
Host: Other big winners of the night included A'ja Wilson of the Las Vegas Aces, who won Best Athlete in Women's Sports and Best WNBA Player, and Shohei Ohtani of the Los Angeles Dodgers, who took home Best Single-Game Performance and Best MLB Player.
[Sound effects: Music and applause continue]
Host: The show was hosted by SNL star Marcello Hernández, who brought the energy and charisma to the stage. The night also featured entertaining performances by the Savannah Bananas, De La Soul, Ghostface Killah, and Slick Rick.
[Music transitions to a heartfelt and emotional tune]
Host: The ESPYS also took the time to honor some incredible individuals, including Jason Collins, who was posthumously awarded the Arthur Ashe Award for Courage, and Jim Abbott, who received the Jimmy V Award for Perseverance.
[Music and sound effects fade out]
Host: That's all for today's podcast. Thanks for tuning in to hear about the 2026 ESPY Awards. Until next time, stay sports-tastic!
[Music and sound effects fade out completely]
